h1: Custom Etched Apparel for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom etched apparel for your team or event. Perfect for logos and text. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom etched apparel uses a laser to remove material from the fabric surface, creating a crisp, permanent mark that won't peel or fade. This technique works especially well on polyester and fleece garments like the Women's Caltech Knit Quarter Zip, giving your logo a subtle, professional texture. Etching is ideal for safety managers needing durable, high-visibility branding or marketing directors seeking a refined look for company uniforms.
heroAltText: Custom etched apparel featuring a laser-etched logo on a women's quarter zip fleece jacket
